Proof in the paper: High-resolution TEM (HRTEM) was then used to precisely characterize the unique surface of the oriented tiny NSs. The thickness of these tiny NSs is less than 2 nm (Fig. 1d, Fig. S2). Two fringes with a lattice spacing of 0.22 and 0.38 nm together with the crystal plane angle of 120 ° are observed at the top surface of the tiny NSs, which correspond to the (015) and (006) planes of NiFe-LDH, respectively.
